description: Use when designing, reviewing, or debugging Apex code that relies on List, Set, or Map collections in triggers, batch classes, or service layers — especially for bulkification, heap management, and safe null handling. Trigger keywords: 'Map<Id, SObject>', 'containsKey', 'retainAll', 'putAll', 'Set intersection', 'heap limit', 'collection in loop', 'unbounded accumulation', 'group by parent Id', 'Comparator', 'Comparable', 'equals and hashCode', 'keySet', 'Set<String> duplicates', '15 vs 18 character Id', 'modify collection while iterating', 'List index out of bounds'. NOT for SOQL query optimization — use apex/soql-fundamentals. NOT for async job design — use apex/apex-queueable-patterns or apex/batch-apex-patterns. NOT for Platform Cache strategies — use apex/platform-cache. NOT for wrapper/DTO class design — use apex/apex-wrapper-class-patterns. NOT for CPU-time tuning — use apex/apex-cpu-and-heap-optimization.
inputs: Apex class or trigger body using List, Set, or Map
Whether the context is a trigger, batch, or service layer
Known governor limit pressure (heap, CPU, SOQL rows)
The access pattern the collection has to serve — ordered, membership, or keyed lookup
Whether keys are record Ids, Strings derived from Ids, or a custom class
name: apex-collections-patterns
official_sources: **Apex Developer Guide — Collections** (`apexdev.txt` L1428–L1710; PDF: https://resources.docs.salesforce.com/262/latest/en-us/sfdc/pdf/salesforce_apex_developer_guide.pdf) — List/Set/Map definitions, "no limit on the number of items a collection can hold" and the heap qualifier (L1431), the seven-levels nesting bound (L1471, L1601, L1657), hash structure for sets and maps (L1640, L1691), deterministic iteration order (L1642, L1692), null map keys and overwrite-on-duplicate (L1694–L1696), case-sensitive String keys (L1697), and equals/hashCode vs field-value uniqueness (L1700–L1703). Supports SKILL.md § Core Concepts, § Key Semantics Differ By Key Type, and gotchas 3, 4, 7, 13.

**Apex Developer Guide — Data Types, Operators and the safe navigation operator** (`apexdev.txt` L1245–L1256, L2129–L2145, L2353–L2360) — the `ID` type converting a 15-character value to its 18-character representation (L1255), `==` semantics for Strings, Ids, user-defined types and sObjects (L2133–L2143), the Decimal-scale hashcode warning (L1245–L1247), and `?.` short-circuiting instead of throwing (L2353–L2355). Supports gotchas 1, 7, 8, 11 and the Questions-to-Ask key-type row.

**Apex Developer Guide — Iterating Collections, Custom Types in Map Keys and Sets, Sorting Lists of sObjects** (`apexdev.txt` L3181–L3203, L7020–L7100, L10235–L10345) — modification during iteration being unsupported (L3182–L3183), the add/remove workarounds (L3192–L3203), `List.remove` performing linearly (L3200), the `equals`/`hashCode` signatures and the `PairNumbers` sample (L7051–L7095), the mutable-key warning (L7040–L7041), and the default sObject sort sequence (L10245–L10258). Supports gotchas 8, 9, 10 and code-examples §3.

**Apex Developer Guide — Execution Governors and Limits; Batch Apex** (`apexdev.txt` L19528–L19580, L39724, L17856) — 100 sync / 200 async SOQL queries (L19544), 6 MB / 12 MB total heap (L19577), per-`execute` limit reset for Batch Apex (L19530–L19531), `System.LimitException` on a heap breach (L39724), and its uncatchability (L17856). Supports gotcha 5 and SKILL.md § Collections Are Bounded By Heap.

**Apex Reference Guide — Map Class, Set Class, List Class** (`apexrefguide.txt` L221038–L221900, L222217–L222920, L230236–L230800; PDF: https://resources.docs.salesforce.com/262/latest/en-us/sfdc/pdf/apexrefguide.pdf) — `Map.get` returning null (L222556–L222557), `keySet()` being backed by the map (L222249, L222682), `values()` returning a list with deterministic order (L222901–L222915), the `Map<ID,sObject>(recordList)` constructor (L222322–L222330), `retainAll`/`removeAll` operating on the receiver (L230690, L230750, L230771), case-sensitive String set elements (L230262–L230263), nulls-first primitive sort and the 15/18-character `List<Id>` sort note (L221858–L221872, L221840–L221841). Supports gotchas 1, 2, 6, 7, 9 and the checker's rule set.

**Apex Reference Guide — Comparator Interface; Limits Class** (`apexrefguide.txt` L202281–L202410, L220709–L220730) — `compare()` returning a negative integer, zero or a positive integer, the mandatory null handling in `compare()` (L202283), and `Limits.getHeapSize()` returning an *approximate* byte count (L220711–L220712). Supports code-examples §2 and the fraction-of-ceiling assertion in §4.

**Apex Developer Guide — Working with SOQL Aggregate Functions; Dynamic SOQL binds** (`apexdev.txt` L9530–L9562, L11466–L11496) — the implied `expr0` alias for un-aliased aggregate fields (L9555–L9557), aggregate rows counting toward the query-row limit (L9558–L9560), and the case-*insensitive* `queryWithBinds` bind map (L11478–L11488). Supports SKILL.md § Grouping Without a Second Query and gotcha 12.
**Salesforce Well-Architected Overview** — https://architect.salesforce.com/docs/architect/well-architected/guide/overview.html — pillar names and framing for the § Relevant Pillars section.
outputs: Refactored collection usage with bulkified patterns
Decision guidance on Map vs Set vs List for the given scenario
A deployable CollectionUtils class, Comparator, and custom key class with tests
